entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
Thank you, Jane. I've got your account pulled up. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not working for me. The whole interface is confusing. Frankly, I expected more from it.
I see. Some of the advanced features can be tricky at first. We find the user manual can be a little dense. Were you having trouble with a specific function?
Look, I don't really have time to troubleshoot. The device is just hard to use. Can I return it, yes or no?
Yes, of course. My apologies. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. One moment please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that the item was delivered 32 days ago. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so I can absolutely process that return for you.
Great. Thank you. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Glad I could help you with that today, Jane. Is there anything else?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
